title: Understanding the Update Rule
text:
The update rule for logistic regression with L2 regularization is given by:

$${	heta}^{t+1}$$ $$=$$ (1-2λ)θ**(t) + \alpha[(y_i - σ(X_i * θ**(t)))X_i]

Here, σ(z) is the sigmoid function, which is defined as σ(z) $$=$$ $$ rac{1}{1+e^{\left(-zight)}}$$.

title: Analyzing the Update Rule
text:
To determine which combination of $${	heta}^t$$, $$X_i$$, $$y_i$$, and λ results in the most positive $${	heta}^{t+1}$$, consider the impact of each term in the update rule:

$$1$$. (1-2λ)θ**(t): This term scales the current weight $${	heta}^t$$ by a factor dependent on λ.
$$2$$. \alpha[(y_i - σ(X_i * θ**(t)))X_i]: This term adjusts the weight based on the difference between the actual and predicted values, scaled by $$X_i$$.

title: Effect of λ on the Update
text:
The term (1-2λ)θ**(t) indicates that:
- If λ > $$0$$, the term reduces the magnitude of $${	heta}^t$$.
- If λ < $$0$$, the term increases the magnitude of $${	heta}^t$$.
- If λ $$=$$ $$0$$, the term does not affect the magnitude of $${	heta}^t$$.

title: Effect of $$y_i$$ and $$X_i$$ on the Update
text:
The term \alpha[(y_i - σ(X_i * θ**(t)))X_i] depends on:
- $$y_i$$: The actual label, which can be $$0$$ or $$1$$.
- σ(X_i * θ**(t)): The predicted probability.
- $$X_i$$: The feature value, which is $$0$$ in this case.

Since $$X_i$$ $$=$$ $$0$$, this term becomes zero, meaning it does not contribute to the update.

title: Determining the Most Positive $${\theta}^{t+1}$$
text:
Given that $$X_i$$ $$=$$ $$0$$, the update rule simplifies to:

$${	heta}^{t+1}$$ $$=$$ (1-2λ)θ**(t)

To maximize $${	heta}^{t+1}$$, consider the effect of λ on $${	heta}^t$$.
